content_blocks.label: clause_1._Testamentary_Intent
content_blocks.text: I, Isabella M. White, being of sound mind and body, do hereby make, publish, and declare this my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Disposal_of_Property
content_blocks.text: I direct that all of my personal property, including but not limited to furniture, jewelry, and household items, be distributed equally among my children, John and Mary White.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Executor
content_blocks.text: I hereby appoint Thomas R. Black as the Executor of my estate, with full power and authority to carry out the provisions of this Will.
